title: Add the authority-at-dispatch and portable receipts presentation to the queue
author: chrisjleal
summary: Adds one entry to the presentation queue in AGENDA.md, in the same form as #16. The row it presents is on #22; the records are the 2 November packet and the operator-run kit at proofable/docs. Proposed for 12 or 19 November. No other file is changed.
